text:
Among things to be seen, what is finer than that deer-eyed face, radiant with love?
Among things to be smelled, what is better than the fragrance of her breath? Among things to be heard, what is better than her words?
Among things to be tasted, what is better than the nectar of her lip-petals? Among things to be touched, what is better than her body, the object of contemplation?
In the bloom of youth, for those with hearts, what is better than her playful charms everywhere?
